name: B2B credit applications with guarantor and credit approval
description: A new B2B customer applies for credit terms on the website. The application is generated and signed by the applicant; over $50,000 a guarantor signs the personal guarantee too. Once signed, an Agreement Desk request is opened and the Credit Team approves or declines it; the outcome is the request's status.
prerequisites: Replace credit.team@example.com in the intake workflow with the credit team's mailbox.
Publish the intake workflow and put its link on the website.

gaps.instead: the applicant answers "Is the requested limit over $50,000?" (Yes/No); that answer shows the guarantor fields and routes the guarantor signature
